I answered Hollis in a thread on his question in #central-team: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at **Gate 47**.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in that channel, then corrected it to Gate 47 because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing posted there since has changed it. I told Hollis about the earlier Dock 23 post so it doesn't end up on the account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used messages he can already see.
